svg.title: Meet the mud creatures — step 5: Meet your new mud friend
svg.desc: Give your creature a name and show what it can do in an imaginary story. Try a second creature with a different shape or mood. Take a picture on the tray before it dries; cracks and crumbles are part of temporary mud art.
